scripts._comment: Bun 1.3.x ignores [test].timeout in bunfig.toml (oven-sh/bun#7789), so the per-test ceiling is set via --timeout in every script. 120s covers Knative cold-start + first request + KEDA worker reaction window; specs that need more (adapter workflows) override it via the third arg to it().
scripts._tier_comment: Multi-tier matrix: `test:shared` exercises the shared CNPG path (default acme tenant), `test:dedicated` provisions a dedicated CNPG Cluster for `acme-dedicated`. Both runs auto-cleanup via `scripts/cleanup-tenant.ts` (set E2E_KEEP_TENANT=1 to keep). `test:all-tiers` runs both sequentially. Cleanup is a SEPARATE bun process — NOT a `*.spec.ts` — because Bun does NOT execute specs in alphabetic order, so a `zz-cleanup` spec runs mid-suite and tears down the tenant before workflow tests query it (stale connection pool → ECONNREFUSED). The `bash -c 'cmd; rc=$?; cleanup; exit $rc'` pattern ensures cleanup runs even when tests fail while still propagating the test exit code.
scripts.test:shared: bash -c 'E2E_TENANT=test-shared-tenant E2E_TENANT_TIER=shared bun test --timeout 120000; rc=$?; E2E_TENANT=test-shared-tenant E2E_TENANT_TIER=shared bun run scripts/cleanup-tenant.ts; exit $rc'
scripts.test:dedicated: bash -c 'E2E_TENANT=test-dedicated-tenant E2E_TENANT_TIER=dedicated bun test --timeout 300000; rc=$?; E2E_TENANT=test-dedicated-tenant E2E_TENANT_TIER=dedicated bun run scripts/cleanup-tenant.ts; exit $rc'
scripts.test:all-tiers: bun run test:shared && bun run test:dedicated
